title: Payment Rails, Authorization Channels and Verification Terms for Each Bluegate AutoPay Authorization Method
content:
**Payments operations standard — Bluegate AutoPay Authorization.** This standard records, per method, the network a method's drafts run on, the NACHA entry class used for an online or a recorded-phone authorization, whether a recorded phone call may carry the authorization, how the tenant receives a copy of it, and how the card or account is verified before any draft runs.

| Method | Payment rail | Entry class, online authorization | Recorded phone authorization allowed | Entry class, phone authorization | Copy of authorization sent by | Verification method | Verification window (calendar days) | Wrong micro-deposit entries allowed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Debit Card | Card network | None (card) | Yes | None | Email | $0.00 authorization on the card | 0 | 0 |
| Credit Card | Card network | None (card) | Yes | None | Email | $0.00 authorization on the card | 0 | 0 |
| Personal Checking ACH | ACH | WEB | Yes | TEL | Email | Micro-deposits to the account | 5 | 3 |
| Personal Savings ACH | ACH | WEB | Yes | TEL | Email | Micro-deposits to the account | 5 | 3 |
| Business Checking ACH | ACH | CCD | No | None | Email | Micro-deposits to the account | 7 | 3 |
| Business Card | Card network | None (card) | Yes | None | Email | $0.00 authorization on the card | 0 | 0 |

### Notes to the table

1. **Rails.** The Debit Card, Credit Card and Business Card methods run on the card networks; the three bank account methods run on ACH.
2. **Entry classes.** The personal bank methods use the WEB class for an online authorization and the TEL class for a recorded-phone authorization. Business Checking ACH uses the CCD class and cannot be authorized by phone, so it has no phone entry class. Card methods carry no entry class.
3. **Phone authorization.** Every method except Business Checking ACH may be authorized on a recorded call at the care center.
4. **Verification.** Cards are verified at once by a $0.00 authorization, so their verification window and micro-deposit allowance are 0. Bank accounts are verified by micro-deposits: 5 calendar days on the personal bank methods and 7 on Business Checking ACH, with 3 wrong amount entries allowed before verification fails.

### Worked reading (hypothetical)

A tenant authorizing Personal Savings ACH by recorded phone call: the drafts will run on ACH under the TEL class, a copy of the authorization goes by email, and the account is verified by micro-deposits within the 5-day window, with up to 3 wrong entries.
